Hi Samantha —

Thanks again for choosing Redwood. To get BlueArc set up in our procurement system and issue POs, finance/procurement will need a short packet of items from your side. Below is what we typically collect and the items we can provide back to you. If anything looks off, call it out and we’ll adapt.

What we need from BlueArc (please reply with attachments or secure links):
- Completed vendor onboarding form (attached PDF) — basic company info + remit details
- Signed W-9 (or local tax form) — for our AP records
- Bank details or ACH setup (we can accept bank detail sheet or DocuSign/secure portal)
- Certificate of insurance (COI) naming Redwood Inference as additional insured (if available)
- SOC2 report or written attestation (if you cannot share the full report, summary + auditor contact is fine)
- Primary billing contact (name, email, phone) and invoice delivery preference (email/EDI/vendor portal)

What we will provide to you:
- Standard Redwood PO template and instructions (PDF)
- Our supplier terms for Net payment window and early-pay options
- Contact for vendor security review and how to submit evidence
\Logistics/questions: please confirm: do you accept electronic POs and invoice-by-email to billing@bluearc.com? Also tell us your preferred payment terms (Net30/Net45/etc.) for new vendor setups.

Attachments: redwood_vendor_form_2026.pdf (fillable)

Best,
Rafael Mendes
Account Executive, Strategic Sales
Redwood Inference
rafael.mendes@redwood.com | (415) 555-0192

Hi Samantha —

Appreciate the fast turnaround and the attachments. A couple of follow-ups from finance/procurement so we can keep the timeline tight:

1) Bank details: can you either complete the DocuSign powerform (https://na1.docusign.net/Member/PowerFormSigning.aspx?PowerFormId=abc123) for ACH setup or send a secure bank detail PDF? We cannot accept bank details in plaintext email for security reasons.

2) SOC2: an NDA is straightforward — I’ve included a link to our standard vendor NDA below (DocuSign). If BlueArc prefers, send auditor contact and we’ll reach out.

3) Payment terms: our standard for new vendors is Net45 for first setups unless sales has a pre-agreed discount plan. Laura (procurement) and Monica (finance) are cc’d to weigh in; if Net30 is required, let’s surface that now so we can route for approval.

Proposed next steps:
- Samantha: complete vendor form + submit ACH via secure powerform (target by EOD Thu)
- Laura: once we have COI + W-9 + vendor form, enter vendor in Coupa (or our AP system) and request PO creation
- Monica: confirm payment window and whether we can do Net30 for this pilot

I’m aiming for a PO to be issued by 2026-07-07 if paperwork lands this week. Thoughts?

Thanks —
Rafael
